---

Three days, one room, 41 of us, and a lot of mathematics.

The Winter School on Elliptic Curves and Modular Forms ran 5–7 November at Seminar Hall 2, Dept of Mathematics, Sahyadri Institute of Science, Pune. We received 112 applications from 9 states and selected 41 participants (MSc and early PhD) on the basis of a written statement and one reference.

This was possible thanks to the Institute's Student Initiative Grant of Rs 2.4 lakh, which covered hostel stay and travel for 18 out-of-station students. We are grateful to the institute for backing a student-run event.

Our sincere thanks to our three speakers: Dr. Nilesh Dharmadhikari (Hyderabad) for the Mordell–Weil sessions, Dr. Sunanda Iyer (Chennai) for the modular forms lectures, and Dr. Tomasz Wierzbicki (Kraków), who joined us online for computations in Sage. Thank you to our faculty mentor, Prof. Anuradha Venkatesan, for guiding us and for making it possible for students to run a school of this kind. Thank you to Mr. Prakash Salunke in the office, who sorted out hostel rooms at 11 pm when a booking went wrong. And thank you to our six PhD student volunteers: the problem sessions they ran worked beautifully, and we want to keep that format.

And thank you to the 41 participants. On day two the power failed for nearly two hours and our laptops died one by one. We pulled two rolling whiteboards into the canteen and carried on with the problem session there. Several people told us afterwards it was the best session of the three days. For MSc students, a small school like this does more than a big conference ever does. You can actually ask the speaker a question, and you get an answer in front of everyone.

One participant from Silchar spotted an error in a worked example in Dr. Iyer's notes. She corrected it live and thanked him. That moment was worth the entire grant.

Slides and problem sheets will go up on the departmental website within two weeks.

We hope to run a second edition in late 2027, depending on renewed grant support. If you would like to attend, teach or help next time, please do get in touch.

Organisers: [Your Name], Ketaki Joglekar, Faizan Mirza.

#EllipticCurves #ModularForms #WinterSchool #SahyadriInstitute #StudentLed
